name: the medium world -- sentence-level cases for Haro v0.33 (INCLUDES, ON a FORM, a quantifier over a FORM; Central's item 4, stzzui's S5; S14)
comment: Written BEFORE any code reads INCLUDES. Each case runs the court forged from medium_v33.haro on haro AND on its checked build; the two must print the same bytes, and the guard also forges v33/medium_expanded.haro, the hand-expanded twin, and requires the same court byte for byte. The sentences are in medium/. M7 and M8 are S14: one where reads two lists. A constraint ON a FORM is enforced on every kind that includes it (M3, M4, M5), except the kinds it EXCEPTs (M16, M17, M18).

cases.name: the clean sentence: three kinds that include the shared guarantees
the meta-court reads the world: three declarations, one form, seven constraints (ON a FORM made three, and ON a FORM EXCEPT one made two)
ON a FORM, on a SCREEN: made once, enforced on the first kind that includes it
contains: medium (line 3): home satisfies CONFIRM and keeps no CANCEL always reachable

cases.name: ON a FORM, on a VIBE
contains: medium (line 3): calm satisfies CONFIRM and keeps no CANCEL always reachable

cases.name: ON a FORM, on a PANEL
contains: medium (line 3): signup satisfies CONFIRM and keeps no CANCEL always reachable

cases.name: the envelope of a constraint made ON a FORM: its code and its cite, as if written by hand
S14, the first list: a verb guaranteed in SATISFIES of any kind, read by a quantifier over the FORM
contains: medium (line 8): VIBE loud puts the surface on print, which carries no ZOOM, and a declaration guarantees it

cases.name: S14, the second list: the same verb in ALWAYS_REACHABLE of another kind, read by the same where
contains: medium (line 8): VIBE loud puts the surface on print, which carries no ZOOM, and a declaration guarantees it

cases.name: the envelope of S14: VERB_NOT_CARRIED, citing rule:medium
on print and no declaration guarantees the verb: lawful
the verb is guaranteed but the surface is visual, which carries it: lawful
ALL over a FORM: one kind names no actor, the sentence stands and the VIBE warns, at its own line
contains: warning NO_ACTOR: VIBE calm: some declaration of the sentence names no actor (line 7)

cases.name: a seat a kind got from the FORM is checked by its own MENU, as a hand-written one is
contains: An intent is confirm, cancel, zoom or read, not 'dance'

cases.name: a seat the kind adds beside the included ones is lawful
EXCEPT: the constraint ON the FORM is made for a SCREEN, which satisfies nothing, and warns at its own line
contains: warning NO_SATISFIES: home satisfies nothing: a surface exists for a reason (line 3)

cases.name: EXCEPT [panel]: the constraint was not made for a PANEL, so a panel that satisfies nothing is lawful and silent
EXCEPT leaves the other kinds: a VIBE that satisfies nothing warns
contains: warning NO_SATISFIES: calm satisfies nothing: a surface exists for a reason (line 3)

cases.name: the expanded kinds are closed: a seat no kind has is refused
